content.title: CVLT Q4 Deep Dive: SaaS Shift and Deal Dynamics Shape Market Reaction
content.summary: Data protection software company Commvault (NASDAQ:CVLT) reported Q4 CY2025 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 19.5% year on year to $313.8 million. The company expects next quarter’s revenue to be around $306.5 million, close to analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.17 per share was 19.2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
